title: ForecastInput: one driver in the ledger that moves a forecast. Row of table forecast_input. Whoever creates it states the source.

target.description: material_no, family_id, funcloc or 'plant' depending on scope

x-bounds.multiply: value between 0.25 and 3.0. Above 2.0 needs two independent evidence ids.
x-bounds.add_qty: value between 0 and 10 times the part's largest monthly issue in history. When that maximum is 0 (no demand in the history): at most the smaller of 10 and the installed quantity, with two independent evidence ids and the flag sparse_history.
x-bounds.set_lead_days: between 1 and 400 and not below the 10th percentile of the part's PO lead times.
x-bounds.set_zero_after: only with driver 'obsolescence' and months_since_last of at least 12.
